platform: desktop (DaVinci Resolve Studio 19.1 build 12, Windows, Fusion page)
description: In a Fusion 3D scene, an image whose alpha comes from a Chroma Keyer hides the inner sphere, while a PNG with a real alpha channel shows it.
expected_report: Scene: a blue inner sphere inside a slightly larger outer sphere textured with a world map. With a PNG that already has alpha, the inner sphere is visible through the transparent parts. When the original image without alpha is keyed with a Chroma Keyer and connected to the outer sphere, the inner sphere disappears even though the keyed areas should be transparent. Expected: keyed transparency behaves like PNG alpha. Moving the inner sphere outside makes it visible again.
difficulty: Dark Resolve UI with tiny node-editor and inspector text, the change is in a 3D viewer, actions are node rewiring in the node graph.
